[Intro]
[Cm]

[Verse 1]
[Cm]Sometimes it feels like it's
meant to be broken
[Fm]Sometimes we long for
the unspoken We
[Abmaj7]try to avoid
[Am7b5]every commotion By
[Abmaj7]showing hardly
[Cm/G]any emotion
[Cm]Sometimes it seems we're
at the wrong station
[Fm]Looking for a deadly
combination
[Abmaj7]Sometimes it feels like i-
[Am7b5]magination
[Abmaj7]Looking for all these
[G]cheap sensations

[Pre-Chorus]
[Cm]Why
don't we go against the tide
[Fm]
Against all their advice
[Abmaj7]We keep running, we
[Am7b5]keep on running It's
[Abmaj7]just a matter of time
[G]Before it

[Chorus]
[Cm]all Echos, echos and
[Eb]goes Crashing against the
[Dm]walls Hold my hand and
[C#]keep your eyes closed Before it
[Cm]all Echos, echos and
[Eb]falls I suppose it's
[Fm]just a matter of time
[G]

it's meant to be broken
